rv.q: Were I a ghost, I would definitely make a point of revisiting the dreary world whenever this rare medium dances.
Every member of the dazzling cast come up to Lansbury’s level once the actress sets foot on stage making for a devilishly delicious evening of theater.

Best Costume Design of a Play

cn.t: Critics praise this frothy Noël Coward revival, with Angela Lansbury's scene-stealing entrance earning extended ovations. The production delivers charming entertainment anchored by its legendary star's magnetic performance.
